We used the Conserved Domain Database to extract the PKD cation channel domain from pkd1L-1 (dd_Smed_v6_13975_0_1) and pkd2L-1 (dd_Smed_v6_ 15626 _0_1) ( Wang et al. 2023 ) and then translated the domain sequences on Expasy ( https://web.expasy.org/translate/ ).
